about_the_game:
Unleash Your Puzzle Mastery in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle!

Dive into a world where strategy meets chaos! Harness the unique skills of each character to dominate the board:

  • Net gems and relocate them for the ultimate setup.

  • Smash through layers of gems with brute force.

  • Crush your opponents' gems by strategically dropping balls on them.

  • Or, for the mischievous mind, torment your opponent by turning their gems black and white, sending their strategy into disarray!

Choose your path, master the chaos, and outwit your foes. The choice is yours in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Ready to play like never before?

Step into a world where every stage is a new spectacle! As you solve puzzles watch the icy excavation site melt into a sea of lava with visuals and sounds heating up the challenge. Navigate through a dystopian Tokyo where the fog grows thicker, the music somber, and the puzzles more enigmatic. Explore a scrapyard in the vastness of space, where the silence of the cosmos is broken by clanking metal, and the stage itself comes alive with each move.

Choose your favorite character, from a bad-mannered witch with even worse-mannered hair, to an amnesic explorer full of grit.

short_description: Pip Puzzle is an action puzzle gem game where you flood your opponent’s side with gems by smashing your own gems. Fight through Arcade, or play online against your friends. Find a character with a unique skill that best fits your play style, and battle through stages that evolve while you play!
